scope: Determine whether the already-open GTK2 applications began before the current selected user theme file, without inspecting application windows or restarting processes.

observed.interpretation: All observed XChat processes started before the selected theme gtkrc mtime. Existing process appearance is therefore not confirmed as the current installed render; GTK2 reload may have occurred, so stale in-memory styling is plausible but not proven.
observed.scope_note: Only process start times and selected theme config file metadata/content were read. No window pixels or chat contents were captured; no XChat was restarted or modified.

result: All observed XChat processes predate the currently selected installed GTK2 gtkrc modification time. This makes stale in-memory styling a plausible explanation for a difference from a fresh process, but does not prove that GTK2 failed to reload the configuration. The existing app appearance remains unverified.
next: If the user still sees a smaller arrow in an open app, compare only its scrollbar region after an explicitly coordinated reload/restart; do not infer its style from process age alone.
